sentences.text: Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Moksha Khajuria Kazmi, Judge

By this petition, petitioner herein has sought jurisdiction of this Court under Article 227 of the Constitution of India thereby seeking direction upon Additional Session Judge, Jammu to decide the application seeking cancellation of anticipatory bail application in terms of judgment passed by Supreme Court in case titled "Rajanti Devi @Rajanti Kumari vs. Union of India"
2.

entities.text: Rajanti Devi @Rajanti Kumari vs. Union of India
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is stated by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the complainant/petitioner herein has filed an application for registration of FIR against the respondent no. 2 for committing fraud and cheating under Section 420, 120-b of IPC before respondent no. 1 and the respondent no. 1 has registered FIR No. 14/2025 against respondent no. 2 and respondent no. 2 was granted the anticipatory bail from the Court of Additional Session Judge, Jammu on 22.03.2025.

entities.text: Court of Additional Session Judge, Jammu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petitioner filed an application seeking cancellation of bail granted to respondent no. 2 on 13.05.2025.
3.

It is also stated by the learned counsel for the petitioner that despite the fact that the objections have been filed in the application seeking cancellation of the bail granted to respondent no. 2 the said application has not been decided by the learned Additional Session Judge, Jammu.

sentences.text: It is also stated by the learned counsel for the petitioner that in terms of judgment passed by the Supreme Court in case titled "Rajanti Devi vs. Union of India", the application which has been filed by the petitioner, has to be decided within four weeks which could extend up to six weeks.

entities.text: Rajanti Devi vs. Union of India
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The proceeding sheets annexed by the petitioner reveals that the Additional Session Judge, Jammu has already heard the application seeking cancellation five times, i.e., 15.05.2025, 16.05.2025,
23.05.2025, 29.05.2025 and 30.05.2025 whereas on 30.05.2025, application filed by the petitioner was heard in part and the same is directed to be listed on 25.06.2025.
5.

It is also stated by the learned counsel for the petitioner that though the application filed by the petitioner has been duly considered, but the same has not been concluded in terms of judgment passed by the Supreme Court in case titled "Rajanti Devi vs. Union of India".
6.

entities.text: Rajanti Devi vs. Union of India
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This Court is of the view that there is no dereliction of duty on the part of the Additional Session Judge, Jammu.

7. Be that as it may, this petition is disposed of thereby requesting the Additional Session Judge,
Jammu to consider and conclude the proceedings in the application filed by the petitioner on 05.11.2025 expeditiously.
